body.en: Project tabs can be dragged to reorder them, torn off into a new window, or moved between windows. Thanks to @knightnemo for the first version (#1013).
body.zh: 现在可以拖动项目标签页来调整顺序、拖出为新窗口，或在窗口之间移动。感谢 @knightnemo 提供最初的版本（#1013）。

body.en: Two open files with the same name now show enough of their folder to tell them apart, hovering a tab shows its path, and the tab menu can copy it.
body.zh: 两个同名的已打开文件现在会显示足够的文件夹信息以便区分；鼠标悬停在标签页上会显示其路径，标签页菜单也可以复制该路径。

title.en: The Agent cites into the right bibliography
title.zh: Agent 将引用写入正确的参考文献

body.en: The Agent now adds citations to the .bib file your document actually uses, cites a GitHub repository by its own citation, finds a reference written out with its authors and year, and finishes upgrading a long bibliography's preprints instead of timing out.
body.zh: Agent 现在会把引用添加到文档实际使用的 `.bib` 文件中，按 GitHub 仓库自身提供的引用格式引用仓库，能找到写明作者和年份的参考文献，并且升级长参考文献中的预印本时能顺利完成而不再超时。

title.zh: 更干净的 Overleaf 同步

body.en: Package cache folders such as _minted and achemso's acs-main.bib stay out of the file tree and sync, your own PDF build is no longer kept as a conflict copy, and a held file move says which role is holding it back.
body.zh: `_minted` 等宏包缓存文件夹以及 achemso 生成的 `acs-main.bib` 不再出现在文件树和同步中；本机自己编译出的 PDF 不再被保留为冲突副本；被暂缓的文件移动会说明是哪个角色导致的。

body.en: Saving a long .tex file no longer rescans its labels from the start for every label, and the word count runs at most every 15 seconds while you keep saving. Thanks to @rawinan-soma for the report (#1025).
body.zh: 保存较长的 `.tex` 文件时，不再为每个标签都从头重新扫描标签；在连续保存期间，字数统计最多每 15 秒运行一次。感谢 @rawinan-soma 的报告（#1025）。

fixes.en: In Vim mode, $ moves to the end of the line in normal mode again instead of typing $$. Thanks to @Thomasbush9 for the report (#1020).
fixes.zh: 在 Vim 模式下，普通模式中的 `$` 重新会移动到行尾，而不再输入 `$$`。感谢 @Thomasbush9 的报告（#1020）。

fixes.en: The window follows the cursor as soon as you drag its title bar, without a short delay. Thanks to @peterwjacko for the report (#1063).
fixes.zh: 拖动标题栏时，窗口会立即跟随光标移动，不再有短暂延迟。感谢 @peterwjacko 的报告（#1063）。

fixes.en: Clean rebuild cleans the document it is about to build, so a paper and its supplement in one folder no longer lose each other's labels.
fixes.zh: “清理并重新编译”现在会清理即将编译的文档，因此同一文件夹中的论文和补充材料不再丢失彼此的标签。

fixes.en: Windows: a project window saved on a screen that is no longer attached opens on the main screen. Thanks to @ivanvykopal for the fix (#1024).
fixes.zh: Windows：保存在已断开的屏幕上的项目窗口现在会在主屏幕上打开。感谢 @ivanvykopal 提供修复（#1024）。
